newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares sharply up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares sharply up on speculative buying.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index was up 2.581 points or 3.04 percent to 87.54 points in late morning trade on Tuesday on speculative institutional buying in stocks of big firms, brokers said.

Brokers said domestic instutitutions which suffered losses in last week's market falls were trying to push up stocks in companies which weigh heavily on the index, including Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co and Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co.
"The morning's rise was mainly due to speculative institutional buying with market fundamentals having changed little," said one broker. "This is reflected in the thin volume."
Brokers said they believed the index would continue to rise but at a slower pace for the rest of Tuesday's session, supported by gains among the shares of major firms.
But they said the emergence of another solid upward trend with active trading would require some more positive market-moving news.
